posts.author: spiderbob
posts.body:
I'm still not sure what exactly the issue you're having is but when I was trying to use this plugin there was an Enemy Note Tag that had to go in the DB that didn't seem to be mentioned in the help file (or at least I missed it).
Here are the notes from a working enemy in a project I was playing with. Obviously you have to tailor the filenames to match yours but here a copy/paste from my db:
<characterName:$slime_Cd1>
<characterIndex:0>
<faceName:monster_mv1>
<faceIndex:1>
<Sideview Battler: slime_1>
Can't remember which but once I added these notes it worked. Not sure if this is your problem but this is what fixed my issue.
